visualizer.name: visualizer
visualizer.label: Aurora visualizer
visualizer.description: The music's spectrum rises behind the player as northern lights. Needs streams that send CORS headers.

artworkAccent.name: artworkAccent
artworkAccent.label: Accent from artwork
artworkAccent.description: Tint the aurora, the play button and highlights with the current artwork's color.

artworkBackground.name: artworkBackground
artworkBackground.label: Background from artwork
artworkBackground.description: Let the sky behind the player take on the artwork's color as well.

useChannelLogos.name: useChannelLogos
useChannelLogos.label: Channel logos
useChannelLogos.description: Show the channel logo instead of its name at the top of the player.

showUpNext.name: showUpNext
showUpNext.label: Up next
showUpNext.description: Show the queued track below the controls. Works for AzuraCast and SAM channels with their Up Next switch on.

showLiveBadge.name: showLiveBadge
showLiveBadge.label: Live DJ badge
showLiveBadge.description: Show a LIVE badge with the streamer name while an AzuraCast channel has a live DJ.

keyboardShortcuts.name: keyboardShortcuts
keyboardShortcuts.label: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboardShortcuts.description: Space plays and stops, M mutes, arrow up and down change the volume.

songSearchEnable.name: songSearchEnable
songSearchEnable.label: Search on artwork click
songSearchEnable.description: Clicking the artwork opens the search URL below for the playing song.

songSearch.name: songSearch
songSearch.label: Search URL
songSearch.description: {query} is replaced with the playing artist and title.

showListeners.name: showListeners
showListeners.label: Listeners tab
showListeners.description: Add a tab listing every current listener: masked IP (such as 93.103.x.x), device and listening time. Off by default for privacy. Needs the AzuraCast (with an API key), Icecast (admin) or Shoutcast (admin) track info method.
